title: feat(qlet): PVM letters UNDEFINED; reverse and face UNDEFINED
science: The `UNDEFINED/UNDEFINED` verdict is a type mismatch dressed as a theorem: PVM letters are the strings {+,-}, incoming locks are 3-tuples, and the selector filters `if lock in PVM_LETTERS` over a set of tuples, so the empty result is guaranteed by construction. 39 PASS checks on a tautology. The only real computation is a decorative exact check that Tr(rho P_pm) = (2/3, 1/3) at k=1, which plays no part in the verdict.
